# @stabgan/openrouter-mcp-multimodal (v5.0.0)

> MCP server — 19 tools, 300+ OpenRouter models. Text chat, vision/audio/video analysis, image/audio/video generation, model catalog, rerank, health check. Node.js 22+ (Docker uses Node 24).

Get a free API key: https://openrouter.ai/keys

## Install

| Method | Command |
| :--- | :--- |
| npx | `npx -y @stabgan/openrouter-mcp-multimodal` (pin: `@5.0.0`) |
| uvx | `uvx mcp-server-openrouter-multimodal` (needs Node 22+; pin: `OPENROUTER_MCP_NPM_VERSION=5.0.0`) |
| Docker | `docker run --rm -i -e OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... stabgan/openrouter-mcp-multimodal:5.0.0` |
| GHCR | `ghcr.io/stabgan/openrouter-mcp-multimodal:5.0.0` |

Full matrix: https://github.com/stabgan/openrouter-mcp-multimodal#install

Required env: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. Optional sandboxes: `OPENROUTER_INPUT_DIR`, `OPENROUTER_OUTPUT_DIR`.

## Tools (19)

- `chat_completion` — sync chat, web search, provider routing, caching, reasoning
- `start_chat_completion` — async background chat job
- `get_chat_completion_status` — poll async chat by `job_id`
- `analyze_image` — vision Q&A (`image_path`, optional `question`)
- `analyze_audio` — transcribe / analyze audio
- `analyze_video` — video Q&A
- `generate_image` — text-to-image via chat completions (+ reference images)
- `generate_image_dedicated` — text-to-image via `/api/v1/images`
- `generate_audio` — TTS / music via chat completions
- `text_to_speech` — dedicated TTS API (voices, speed, format)
- `speech_to_text` — dedicated STT API (Whisper, GPT-4o transcribe)
- `generate_video` — async text-to-video
- `generate_video_from_image` — image-to-video
- `get_video_status` — poll / resume video jobs
- `search_models` — paginated catalog search
- `get_model_info` — pricing, context, modalities
- `validate_model` — cheap model ID check
- `rerank_documents` — OpenRouter `/rerank`
- `health_check` — API key + reachability probe

Errors: `_meta.code` — `INVALID_INPUT`, `UNSAFE_PATH`, `UPSTREAM_HTTP`, `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT`, `MODEL_NOT_FOUND`, `JOB_STILL_RUNNING`, etc.

## Binary tool results (v4.7.0+)

Generate tools with optional `save_path`:

- **`save_path` set** → text pointer + `_meta.save_path` only (no inline media)
- **no `save_path`, under ceiling** → inline media (video uses MCP `resource` blocks)
- **no `save_path`, over ceiling** → text hint to use `save_path`

Inline defaults: image/audio 1 MiB, video 10 MiB. Env: `OPENROUTER_INLINE_MAX_BYTES`, `OPENROUTER_IMAGE_INLINE_MAX_BYTES`, `OPENROUTER_AUDIO_INLINE_MAX_BYTES`, `OPENROUTER_VIDEO_INLINE_MAX_BYTES`.

## Security

- Input/output path sandboxes (`OPENROUTER_INPUT_DIR`, `OPENROUTER_OUTPUT_DIR`); bypass `OPENROUTER_ALLOW_UNSAFE_PATHS=1`
- SSRF blocklist on URL fetches
- Async `job_id` disk reads sandboxed (4.7.0)
- Report issues: SECURITY.md (private disclosure)
